integrity: Analytic strict convexity, exact 2-class block spectral formula and boundary calculus prove the claim. A standalone standard-library exact rational checker passed 712 tests. Finite tests do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact homogeneous complete split graphs and nonnegative total-sum grounding gains only; critical size-layer constant c=sqrt(2) excluded from asymptotic sign statement; no independent validation or exhaustive priority determination.
title: Reentrant clique grounding and a three-quarter-power imbalance law on complete split networks
